methods.name: Partial dependence, one and two features, on pdp::partial's grid rules (one PDP/ICE engine, incl. the GBM and CART helpers)
methods.reference: pdp::partial (pdp 0.8.3, brute force): pdp:::pred_grid min(length(unique(x)), 51) uniform points by default, seq(min(x), max(x), length.out = grid.resolution) and quantile(x, probs, type = 7, na.rm = TRUE); pred.grid (sorted by order_grid) for two predictors; mean of the predictions
quantities: default grid min(length(unique(x)), 51) and its PD, on a feature above and a feature below the cap
quantile grids at probs 1:9/10 and seq(0, 1, length.out = 20)
tied feature: unique quantile grid values and their PD
1e-12-scale feature: 9 distinct quantile and uniform grid points and their PD
GBM and CART helpers: pdp's uniform grid, PD identical to the engine on the same model
methods.tolerance: grids exact (R's seq.default and quantile.default operations); PD values 1e-12 relative + 1e-12 absolute (closed-form lm predictions; only the summation order differs, measured <= 8.9e-16 * max(|R|, 1))

deviations.note: An exact duplicate grid value is listed once; pdp repeats the row with the same yhat. The ties pin compares with R's unique().
A NaN prediction propagates into the PD mean; pdp's mean(na.rm = TRUE) drops it, which would average over a subset of the rows without saying so.

deviations.quantity: default grid size with missing feature values
deviations.note: The default grid counts non-missing values; pdp's length(unique(x)) counts a missing value as one more point.

methods.name: ICE and centred ICE curves (pdp::partial(ice = TRUE, center = TRUE)), with the per-point spread statistics
methods.reference: pdp::partial(ice = TRUE, center = TRUE) (pdp 0.8.3): curves on the sorted pred.grid, centred at the smallest grid value; population SD, range and stats::IQR (type 7) per grid point
quantities: unsorted user grid sorted as order_grid
ICE curves and their mean on the user grid
centred ICE curves and their mean
8-point uniform ICE grid, curves and mean
per-point population SD, range and IQR (type 7)
default grid min(length(unique(x)), 51) and the mean of its curves
methods.tolerance: grids exact; curves, means and spread statistics 1e-12 relative + 1e-12 absolute (closed-form lm predictions)
